topic: 基础综合复测与薄弱项整理
grammarFocus: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习。
title: The Community Pool Schedule Meeting
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习，适合B1水平学习者。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答问题。题目包括单选题和填空题。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定的词数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Tom. Are you free to talk about the pool schedule for next week?
Tom: Yes, I am. But I only have ten minutes. I need to go to the pool at eleven.
Mia: That's fine. So, the first thing is the swimming lessons on Monday. We have three classes now, not two.
Tom: Three? Last week we had two. Why the change?
Mia: Because more children want to learn. The new class is for beginners at 4 p.m.
Tom: OK. And who teaches it?
Mia: Sarah does. She is a good teacher. She taught the advanced class last year.
Tom: Good. What about the water aerobics class on Wednesday?
Mia: That class is at 10 a.m., not 9 a.m. The teacher, Mr. Lee, asked for the change.
Tom: So the pool is free at 9 a.m. on Wednesday?
Mia: Yes, it is. We can use that hour for open swimming.
Tom: Great. Now, the pool cleaning on Thursday. Is it still at 2 p.m.?
Mia: No, it is at 3 p.m. this week. The cleaning company is coming later.
Tom: So the pool is closed from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. on Thursday?
Mia: That's right. And on Friday, we have a swimming competition for children. It starts at 9 a.m. and finishes at 12 p.m.
Tom: Do we need more people to help?
Mia: Yes, we need two more helpers. Can you ask your friend Jack?
Tom: I can ask him, but he is busy on Friday morning. He works at the shop.
Mia: OK, I will ask my sister. She is free on Friday.
Tom: Good. One more thing: the pool opens at 7 a.m. every day, right?
Mia: Yes, but on Sunday it opens at 8 a.m. because the staff meeting is at 7 a.m.
Tom: I see. Thanks for the information. I need to go now. See you later!
Mia: See you, Tom!

questions.evidence: That class is at 10 a.m., not 9 a.m.

questions.explanation: Mia说“No, it is at 3 p.m. this week.”，所以清洁在下午3点。
questions.evidence: No, it is at 3 p.m. this week.

grammar.title: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习
grammar.explanation: 本练习复习一般现在时（表示习惯或事实）、一般过去时（表示过去发生的事）、特殊疑问句（如What time...? Who...?）、名词单复数（如class→classes, helper→helpers）以及常见从句（如because引导的原因状语从句）。注意：一般现在时中，主语为第三人称单数时动词加-s（如She teaches）；一般过去时动词用过去式（如taught）。
grammar.example: She taught the advanced class last year.

options: She teach the advanced class last year.
She taught the advanced class last year.
She teaches the advanced class last year.
answers: She taught the advanced class last year.
questions.explanation: 句子中有last year，表示过去，所以动词用过去式taught。
questions.evidence: She taught the advanced class last year.

questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句结构：疑问词 + be动词 + 主语。所以是What time is the class?
questions.evidence: What time is the water aerobics class on Wednesday?
We have three classes now, not two.

options: The pool opens at 8 a.m. because the staff meeting is at 7 a.m.
The pool opens at 8 a.m. because the staff meeting are at 7 a.m.
The pool opens at 8 a.m. because the staff meeting at 7 a.m.
answers: The pool opens at 8 a.m. because the staff meeting is at 7 a.m.
questions.explanation: because引导原因状语从句，从句中主语the staff meeting是单数，所以用is。
questions.evidence: on Sunday it opens at 8 a.m. because the staff meeting is at 7 a.m.
